panels.shot: The ballroom balcony. Commissioner Vane (silver hair, dress uniform, medals) raises a glass. Policemen line the walls. A red wax seal on the programme in a guest's hand.

lines.speaker: Vane
lines.text: To a safer Valmora. And to silence, which is the beginning of order.

panels.shot: Close-up. Nero lifts his nose at a door marked Private, whining and pawing. A thin curl of pipe smoke under the door.

lines.text: Cherry tobacco. Bell's tobacco. The dog smelled a ghost.

panels.shot: Vane, from the balcony, sees the hero. She lowers her glass and touches her radio.
